directions.idea: Claridad de producto: titular a dos tonos, tarjeta de valoración gratuita y una calculadora hipotecaria fija que te acompaña mientras lees, en violeta sobre blanco.
Rejilla a la vista, etiquetas técnicas y una tabla que dice qué incluye cada servicio, qué cuesta y qué falta por confirmar. Sin adornos y sin letra pequeña.
De barrio: cercana y práctica. Una calle de Valencia, qué hacemos, dónde estamos, el horario y cómo hablar con nosotros desde la primera pantalla, con WhatsApp siempre a mano.

choice.notes: Owner's choice (2026-10-30): a mix of a and c with a as the base. Keep a's grammar: split hero with the free-valuation card, the sticky mortgage calculator beside the educational blocks, hairline rails, the product-like clarity. Take from c: the real full-bleed Valencia photograph (or another licensed Valencia street or facade photo) and the practical local strip (where, when, how to reach the agency) so it feels like a neighbourhood agency, not a SaaS. Palette: neither a's cold violet nor c's olive as-is; choose a new palette that reads as real estate and trust (ui-ux-pro-max only), warm rather than cold. Typography: a clean sans like a's, not c's rounded display. Palette revision (owner, 2026-10-30, after the first full build): the brick primary is not right. Use a real-estate palette inspired by the owner's Pinterest board: deep navy as the primary (trust), warm sand/taupe as the secondary, cream paper and a near-black ink; terracotta only as a small accent (a Valencia nod). Keep it warm, not cold corporate blue. Palette and tokens from ui-ux-pro-max only; keep IBM Plex Sans unless the new palette clearly asks otherwise; keep the structure, sections and copy of the first build.
